criteria.label: CPU performance
criteria.definition: How fast it compiles code and runs tools like Docker and IDEs.

criteria.label: Battery life
criteria.definition: Hours of real work on one charge, away from a plug.

criteria.label: Keyboard comfort
criteria.definition: How pleasant the keys are for long typing sessions.

criteria.label: Display quality
criteria.definition: Sharpness, brightness and eye comfort of the screen.

criteria.label: Weight
criteria.definition: How heavy it is to carry every day; lighter is better.

criteria.label: Build durability
criteria.definition: How well the body, hinge and ports hold up over years.

criteria.label: Value for money
criteria.definition: How much laptop you get for the price you pay.
